The '''Arkanian pistol''' was a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] that was made by the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanians]] during the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. A variant of it was the [[Arkanian heavy pistol]].
